comment: The images of the run of the PostgreSQL and MySQL servers of the tests, which scripts/persist-servers.mts writes into the Compose file of a run, the project that bay starts (docs/plans/fsm-v1/plan.md, C-6; S-472-1, S-475, S-475-7). Each image is pinned by the digest of its index, which names one image for every platform; version names the release that the digest holds. make persist-images pulls them with bay pull. A new release replaces the version and the digest of its entry together.

postgres.memoryReason: above the peak of 380 MiB of PostgreSQL in a run on a Linux machine of 3.7 GB, whose containers of bay are ended at 3.0 GB together (S-475-11)
postgres.reason: a tag such as postgres:17 names another image after each release of the image, so the result of a run would depend on the day of its pull; the digest names the same bytes on Darwin and on Linux, the release of the PostgreSQL server of orm's tests
postgres.removal: when no test of fsm runs on a PostgreSQL server, the entry leaves with the targets of the PostgreSQL dialect

mysql.memoryReason: above the peak of 552 MiB of MySQL in a run on a Linux machine of 3.7 GB, whose containers of bay are ended at 3.0 GB together (S-475-11)
mysql.reason: a tag such as mysql:8.4 names another image after each release of the image, so the result of a run would depend on the day of its pull; the digest names the same bytes on Darwin and on Linux, the release of the MySQL server of orm's tests
mysql.removal: when no test of fsm runs on a MySQL server, the entry leaves with the targets of the MySQL dialect

runner.memoryReason: above the peak of 2506 MiB of the installation in the runner on a Linux machine of 3.7 GB, whose containers of bay are ended at 3.0 GB together: the job build installs with no server, so its limit stays below 3.0 GB; the job check runs the targets with the same limit (S-475-11)
runner.reason: the service runner of a run executes the targets in a container, so that the machine of a run needs sh and bay alone; a tag such as debian:trixie names another image after each release of the image, and the digest names the same bytes on every machine. Debian trixie holds PHP 8.4 and Composer as packages
runner.removal: when an image of the toolchains replaces it (S-475-8), or when no target of fsm runs on a server of a container
runner.packagesReason: what make bootstrap, make install and the database targets of the suite start beside the tools that mise installs: git for the clone of the bundle, make, a C toolchain and OpenSSL for the builds of the packages, curl, xz and unzip for the downloads of the installation, and PHP 8.4 with Composer, which the checkout does not install
